annotations.title: Domain lookup: DNS, SSL, registration and email security

description: One node for a domain: its DNS records, HTTPS certificate, registration and expiry, or an email-security check with a score. Pick an action; each is a fraction of a cent. Use it when: A task needs facts about a domain: where it points, whether its certificate is about to expire, who registered it and when it lapses, or whether its email will pass SPF, DKIM and DMARC. Not for: Buying or transferring domains, or private registrant contact details (redacted by registries). Returns: Depends on the action; see the actions table. Typical time: about 2 s. Actions: dns (every public dns record of a domain; needs domain); ssl (the https certificate a domain serves; needs domain); registration (who registered a domain and when it expires; needs domain); email_auth (how well a domain's email is authenticated; needs domain). Price: from $0.003 per check, charged only on success. Price depends on action: dns $0.003, ssl $0.003, email_auth $0.003, registration $0.003 (default dns). One call = one domain check (DNS, SSL, registration or email security).

action.description: What to check; each action has its own price. Default dns

domain.description: A domain name, e.g. stripe.com (a URL works too)
